detailed_descriptions.en: Dive into an epic new chapter of Spellcaster University's magical world with the "Steam Age" expansion! Gain access to new goblin cards by collaborating with an engineer, temporarily destabilizing your school in exchange for new opportunities. Hire goblins to maintain your new steam machines. Capitalize on the adjacency mechanics of the new goblin rooms. 9 new rooms, 8 new artifacts, 3 new familiars, 2 new pieces of equipment, various goblin types, and more! All rooms from the base game now have rare and legendary variants, each providing special buffs to help specialize your school. Battle the bitter cold of the ice expanse. Negotiate with mammoth-folk, purchase woolly hats and scarves for your students, and work with the goblins to beat the biting cold. Discover the delights of the toxic canyon. Admire the radioactive lake, handle your students' toxic mutations, and assist the Goblin King.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Dive into an epic new chapter of Spellcaster University's magical world with the "Steam Age" expansion!

  • Gain access to new goblin cards by collaborating with an engineer, temporarily destabilizing your school in exchange for new opportunities.

  • Hire goblins to maintain your new steam machines. 

  • Capitalize on the adjacency mechanics of the new goblin rooms.

  •  9 new rooms, 8 new artifacts, 3 new familiars, 2 new pieces of equipment, various goblin types, and more!

  • All rooms from the base game now have rare and legendary variants, each providing special buffs to help specialize your school.

  • Battle the bitter cold of the ice expanse. Negotiate with mammoth-folk, purchase woolly hats and scarves for your students, and work with the goblins to beat the biting cold.

  • Discover the delights of the toxic canyon. Admire the radioactive lake, handle your students' toxic mutations, and assist the Goblin King.
